summary: The old harness cannot reach the specified UTF-32 composition behavior on either source version.

assessment.necessity_reason: The harness copies fuzzer bytes into a UTF-32 buffer and calls normalization, so a finite input can contain composable codepoints separated by 0x110000. Each direct call omits COMPOSE. The UTF-8 mapping calls cannot provide that out-of-range entry as an equivalent route.

before.requirement: When normalizing UTF-32 with COMPOSE, preserve an out-of-range entry and prevent composition across it.
before.reason: The source passes the entry through and resets composition state, but the old harness never enables COMPOSE for its direct UTF-32 calls. UTF-8 decoding cannot supply 0x110000.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The UTF-8 decoder rejects encodings outside the Unicode codepoint range.
The UTF-8 mapping decomposition route rejects an out-of-range codepoint.

after.requirement: When normalizing UTF-32 with COMPOSE, preserve an out-of-range entry and prevent composition across it.
after.reason: The composition guard remains, while the same old harness still omits COMPOSE from every direct UTF-32 call. UTF-8 mapping remains unable to carry the out-of-range entry.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The UTF-8 decoder rejects encodings outside the Unicode codepoint range.
The UTF-8 mapping decomposition route still rejects an out-of-range codepoint.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: These alternate normalization and mapping calls take the input as UTF-8 rather than preserving an out-of-range UTF-32 entry.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same COMPOSE-gated UTF-32 behavior exists on both sides, and the same fixed option choices prevent the old harness from reaching it on both sides.
